data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 3.6 million in prior year reserves, primarily driven by an improvement in the 2021 year of account's final profit compared to its previous forecast. This favorable development is also supported by underlying attritional losses developing within expectations for the fourth consecutive year. The 2020 and prior years of account were reinsured to close in 2023, transferring their liabilities. Specific events like Hurricanes Ian & Ida (2021), geopolitical events in Ukraine (2021), Storm Uri (2021), Hurricane Ian (2022), Winter storm Elliott (2022), and Hawaii wildfires (2022) impacted prior years, but the overall development for 2021 was positive.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -3.6m is derived from the improvement in the 2021 year of account profit compared to its prior forecast, and is a net figure. No explicit gross prior year development figure was found. The claims development triangle shows 0.0 movement for 2021 and 2022, which contradicts the narrative of an 'improvement on forecast result' for 2021. The 2020 and prior years of account were reinsured to close in 2023, so their development is not reflected as a direct reserve movement.
